settings.repere: Bouton · What is LIVFRESH?
settings.text: What is LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH started because traditional too
settings.text: LIVFRESH started because traditional toothpaste simply wasn’t working. Our founder, Amit Goswamy, was brushing, flossing and rinsing twice a day and still dealing with plaque buildup, bad breath and bleeding gums. The habits weren’t the problem. The product was.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Traditional toothpaste relies on abrasiv
settings.text: Traditional toothpaste relies on abrasives and friction to clean your teeth, which makes it hard to clean along the gumline and in tight spaces, exactly where plaque builds up. So Amit and our chief scientist spent over a decade developing a different approach.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The result is Activated Edathamil, our p
settings.text: The result is Activated Edathamil, our patented ingredient. While you brush, it works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away easily. It’s a superior clean without any abrasives.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is backed by over $20 million i
settings.text: LIVFRESH is backed by over $20 million in R&D, 40+ research studies at top U.S. universities, 40 global patents, and research grants from the U.S. Department of Defense and the National Institutes of Health. Proudly made in the USA, trusted by over 1 million customers, and supported by nearly 3,000 dentists and hygienists.

settings.repere: Bouton · Why should I switch to LIVFRESH?
settings.text: Why should I switch to LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH cleans differently than traditi
settings.text: LIVFRESH cleans differently than traditional toothpaste: chemistry, not just scrubbing.

settings.repere: Texte · While you brush: our patented Activated
settings.text: While you brush: our patented Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away, even along the gumline and in tight spaces where traditional toothpaste struggles.

settings.repere: Texte · After you brush: brushing with LIVFRESH
settings.text: After you brush: brushing with LIVFRESH leaves a clean tooth surface and helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The results:
settings.text: The results:

settings.repere: Texte · Brushing with LIVFRESH removes plaque 25
settings.text: Brushing with LIVFRESH removes plaque 250% better than a leading ADA-approved toothpaste (our fluoride-free gels and Kids+)

settings.repere: Texte · Gum Protect+ is clinically shown to help
settings.text: Gum Protect+ is clinically shown to help reduce gingival inflammation and gum bleeding 400% better than an ADA-approved toothpaste

settings.repere: Texte · Brushing with Gum Protect+ delivers bett
settings.text: Brushing with Gum Protect+ delivers better plaque control than a leading ADA-approved toothpaste

settings.repere: Texte · Gum Protect+ is clinically proven to rem
settings.text: Gum Protect+ is clinically proven to remineralize better than nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste, and aids in the prevention of cavities

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our fluoride-free gels are made with saf
settings.text: Our fluoride-free gels are made with safe ingredients and are free from SLS, parabens, phthalates, abrasives, peroxide and Triclosan.

settings.text: Which fluoride-free formula is right for me?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · All of our fluoride-free gels are powere
settings.text: All of our fluoride-free gels are powered by the same patented Activated Edathamil. Choose based on flavor and feel:

settings.text: Wintergreen (foaming): our #1 bestseller. Refreshing wintergreen with a satisfying foam.

settings.repere: Texte · Peppermint (non-foaming): classic pepper
settings.text: Peppermint (non-foaming): classic peppermint in a smooth, non-foaming gel.

settings.repere: Texte · Mild Peppermint (non-foaming, dye-free):
settings.text: Mild Peppermint (non-foaming, dye-free): our gentlest routine. No foam, no dye, a soft peppermint flavor, and safe to swallow.

settings.repere: Texte · Arctic Peppermint (foaming): a cool, str
settings.text: Arctic Peppermint (foaming): a cool, strong peppermint for extra-fresh breath.

settings.repere: Texte · Kids+ Bubblegum (non-foaming, dye-free):
settings.text: Kids+ Bubblegum (non-foaming, dye-free): the same science-backed clean, specifically formulated for kids. See the Kids+ section below.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · All are fluoride-free, made with safe in
settings.text: All are fluoride-free, made with safe ingredients, and free from SLS, parabens, phthalates, abrasives, peroxide and Triclosan.

settings.repere: Bouton · How does LIVFRESH compare to other tooth
settings.text: How does LIVFRESH compare to other toothpastes?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Most toothpastes rely on abrasives and f
settings.text: Most toothpastes rely on abrasives and friction to scrub plaque off your teeth. LIVFRESH takes a different approach. Our patented Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away easily. It’s a superior clean without any abrasives.

settings.repere: Bouton · Why is LIVFRESH priced the way it is?
settings.text: Why is LIVFRESH priced the way it is?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is engineered, not just formula
settings.text: LIVFRESH is engineered, not just formulated. Our patented Activated Edathamil took over a decade of research and over $20 million in R&D to develop, and every tube is made in the USA. It’s backed by 40 global patents and 40+ research studies at top U.S. universities, which are the gold standard of research, but also the most expensive.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · On a per-use basis, LIVFRESH comes out t
settings.text: On a per-use basis, LIVFRESH comes out to about $0.20 per brushing, less than a cup of coffee. Our Subscribe & Save program and current offers are the best ways to save. If cost is a concern, reach out. We’re passionate about making better oral care accessible to everyone.

settings.repere: Bouton · What is a gel toothpaste?
settings.text: What is a gel toothpaste?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is a pressure-release gel, not
settings.text: LIVFRESH is a pressure-release gel, not a thick, opaque paste. As you brush, the gel releases and spreads evenly across your teeth and into tight spaces. It feels different at first, and that’s the point.

settings.repere: Bouton · Does LIVFRESH help with enamel or remine
settings.text: Does LIVFRESH help with enamel or remineralization?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our fluoride-free gels are made for enam
settings.text: Our fluoride-free gels are made for enamel care, without abrasives: a superior clean with no scrubbing, powered by our patented Activated Edathamil.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If remineralization and cavity protectio
settings.text: If remineralization and cavity protection are what you’re looking for, we recommend Gum Protect+. It’s powered by clinically proven stannous fluoride, which strengthens enamel, helps remineralize teeth and aids in the prevention of cavities. Gum Protect+ is clinically proven to remineralize better than nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste.

settings.repere: Bouton · Does LIVFRESH whiten teeth? Will it stai
settings.text: Does LIVFRESH whiten teeth? Will it stain?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Brushing with LIVFRESH whitens teeth, wi
settings.text: Brushing with LIVFRESH whitens teeth, without peroxides, and our gels won’t stain your teeth. For dedicated whitening, try our Coconut Whitening Strips.

settings.repere: Bouton · Should I choose fluoride-free or Gum Pro
settings.text: Should I choose fluoride-free or Gum Protect+?

settings.repere: Texte · Fluoride-free is your preference and you
settings.text: Fluoride-free is your preference and you want a powerful daily clean: choose any of our fluoride-free gels.

settings.repere: Texte · You want stannous fluoride’s gum and cav
settings.text: You want stannous fluoride’s gum and cavity benefits plus enhanced cleaning: choose Gum Protect+.

settings.repere: Texte · Best of both: some customers use a fluor
settings.text: Best of both: some customers use a fluoride-free gel in the morning and Gum Protect+ at night.

settings.repere: Bouton · Which LIVFRESH products should I use tog
settings.text: Which LIVFRESH products should I use together?

settings.repere: Texte · Gel toothpaste (twice daily): choose the
settings.text: Gel toothpaste (twice daily): choose the formula that fits your needs. Brushing with Activated Edathamil helps break up plaque so brushing lifts it away.

settings.repere: Texte · Mouthwash (after brushing): the same pat
settings.text: Mouthwash (after brushing): the same patented technology in liquid form. It helps rinse buildup away before it hardens into tartar and reaches the areas your brush may miss. As part of your brushing routine, it delivers 163% better tartar control than a leading mouthwash brand.

settings.repere: Texte · Coconut Whitening Strips (as needed): br
settings.text: Coconut Whitening Strips (as needed): brush first, dry your teeth, then apply for 20–30 minutes. Brushing with LIVFRESH first leaves a cleaner surface, which helps the whitening work more effectively.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our gel toothpastes and Mouthwash are pr
settings.text: Our gel toothpastes and Mouthwash are proudly made in the USA, and LIVFRESH was formulated by scientists that graduated from Berkeley and Stanford. We keep manufacturing in the USA to ensure the highest quality standards, even though it costs more than manufacturing abroad.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can you explain the science behind LIVFR
settings.text: Can you explain the science behind LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is powered by our patented Acti
settings.text: LIVFRESH is powered by our patented Activated Edathamil, developed over a decade of research and more than $20 million in R&D. Most toothpastes rely on abrasives and friction; LIVFRESH uses chemistry. While you brush, Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away, even along the gumline and in tight spaces. Brushing with LIVFRESH also helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our Mouthwash uses the same patented tec
settings.text: Our Mouthwash uses the same patented technology in liquid form, helping rinse away buildup before it hardens into tartar.

settings.repere: Bouton · What are the ingredients in the fluoride
settings.text: What are the ingredients in the fluoride-free gels?

settings.repere: Texte · Peppermint (non-foaming): Aqua, Sulfonyl
settings.text: Peppermint (non-foaming): Aqua, Sulfonylbismethane (aka Dimethyl Sulfone), disodium EDTA (aka Edathamil), Propylene Glycol, (Refined Iota-) Carrageenan Gum, Xanthan Gum, Stevia (Leaf), Peppermint, Menthol, FD&C Blue 1

settings.repere: Texte · Mild Peppermint (non-foaming, dye-free):
settings.text: Mild Peppermint (non-foaming, dye-free): Aqua, Sulfonylbismethane (aka Dimethyl Sulfone), disodium EDTA (aka Edathamil), Propylene Glycol, (Refined Iota-) Carrageenan Gum, Xanthan Gum, Stevia (Leaf), Peppermint, Menthol

settings.repere: Texte · Wintergreen (foaming): Aqua, Sulfonylbis
settings.text: Wintergreen (foaming): Aqua, Sulfonylbismethane (aka Dimethyl Sulfone), disodium EDTA (aka Edathamil), Propylene Glycol, (Refined Iota-) Carrageenan Gum, Xanthan Gum, Stevia (Leaf), Wintergreen, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Menthol, FD&C Blue 1

settings.repere: Texte · Arctic Peppermint (foaming): Aqua, Sulfo
settings.text: Arctic Peppermint (foaming): Aqua, Sulfonylbismethane, Edathamil, Propylene Glycol, (Refined Iota-) Carrageenan Gum, Xanthan Gum, Stevia (Leaf), Peppermint, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Menthol, Brilliant Blue FCF

settings.repere: Texte · Kids+ Bubblegum (non-foaming, dye-free):
settings.text: Kids+ Bubblegum (non-foaming, dye-free): Aqua, Sulfonylbismethane (aka Dimethyl Sulfone), disodium EDTA (aka Edathamil), Natural Bubblegum Flavor, (Refined Iota-) Carrageenan Gum, Sodium Hydroxide, Xanthan Gum, Stevia (Leaf)

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No gluten, sugar, parabens, phthalates,
settings.text: No gluten, sugar, parabens, phthalates, abrasives, SLS or Triclosan.

settings.repere: Bouton · Are there any ingredient concerns I shou
settings.text: Are there any ingredient concerns I should know about?

settings.repere: Texte · Propylene glycol: a common ingredient th
settings.text: Propylene glycol: a common ingredient that keeps the gel smooth and stable, found in many toothpastes and widely used in food and pharmaceutical applications. It’s sometimes confused with ethylene glycol (antifreeze), but they’re completely different ingredients.

settings.repere: Texte · Activated Edathamil: our patented ingred
settings.text: Activated Edathamil: our patented ingredient. While you brush, it helps break up and unglue plaque so brushing lifts it away, with no abrasives.

settings.repere: Texte · Stevia: a natural sweetener. No sugar an
settings.text: Stevia: a natural sweetener. No sugar and no artificial sweeteners.

settings.repere: Texte · FD&C Blue 1: a safe color additive that
settings.text: FD&C Blue 1: a safe color additive that helps you see you’re using a pea-sized amount. Mild Peppermint and Kids+ Bubblegum are dye-free. (On Arctic Peppermint it’s listed as Brilliant Blue FCF, the same color additive.)

settings.repere: Texte · Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate: a gentle, SLS
settings.text: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate: a gentle, SLS-free foaming agent used in our foaming formulas (Wintergreen, Arctic Peppermint and Gum Protect+). Peppermint, Mild Peppermint and Kids+ Bubblegum are non-foaming.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Questions about a specific ingredient? R
settings.text: Questions about a specific ingredient? Reach out anytime.

settings.repere: Bouton · Why do some formulas foam and others don
settings.text: Why do some formulas foam and others don’t?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our pa
settings.text: Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our patented formula does. Many people are sensitive to foaming agents, and foam isn’t needed for the clean, so we offer both. Our foaming formulas use a mild, coconut-derived foaming agent called sodium cocoyl isethionate (not SLS). Our non-foaming formulas (Peppermint, Mild Peppermint and Kids+) skip it entirely.

settings.text: Are LIVFRESH products safe and healthy?

settings.repere: Texte · Our fluoride-free gels are made with saf
settings.text: Our fluoride-free gels are made with safe ingredients, and our non-foaming formulas are made with safe, food-grade ingredients

settings.repere: Texte · Free from SLS, parabens, phthalates, Tri
settings.text: Free from SLS, parabens, phthalates, Triclosan, peroxide and abrasives

settings.repere: Texte · No sugar, no gluten
settings.text: No sugar, no gluten

settings.repere: Texte · Cruelty-free and vegan
settings.text: Cruelty-free and vegan

settings.repere: Texte · Non-detectable for arsenic, lead, mercur
settings.text: Non-detectable for arsenic, lead, mercury and cadmium in independent third-party ED-XRF testing

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH free of toxic metals?
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH free of toxic metals?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. LIVFRESH has undergone independent,
settings.text: Yes. LIVFRESH has undergone independent, third-party toxic metal testing using ED-XRF (energy-dispersive X-ray fluorescence), which can detect heavy metals down to parts-per-million. Our gel toothpastes came back non-detectable for arsenic, lead, mercury and cadmium.

settings.repere: Bouton · Are LIVFRESH products fragrance-free?
settings.text: Are LIVFRESH products fragrance-free?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our gels use natural flavoring ingredien
settings.text: Our gels use natural flavoring ingredients (like peppermint, menthol, wintergreen and bubblegum) for taste, not added fragrance. For the mildest flavor, try Mild Peppermint.

settings.repere: Bouton · Are LIVFRESH ingredients ethically sourc
settings.text: Are LIVFRESH ingredients ethically sourced?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. We’re committed to responsible sour
settings.text: Yes. We’re committed to responsible sourcing. Our products are cruelty-free, vegan and proudly made in the USA. If you have a specific sourcing question, we’re happy to look into it.

settings.repere: Bouton · How do I use the gel toothpaste?
settings.text: How do I use the gel toothpaste?

settings.repere: Texte · Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry
settings.text: Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry brush.

settings.repere: Texte · Don’t wet the brush after applying. The
settings.text: Don’t wet the brush after applying. The gel is water-soluble and will dissolve off the bristles.

settings.repere: Texte · Spread the gel across all your teeth, th
settings.text: Spread the gel across all your teeth, then brush at a 45-degree angle with a soft-to-medium brush for 2 minutes (about 30 seconds per quadrant). Don’t forget the backs of your teeth and your tongue.

settings.repere: Texte · Rinse as normal.
settings.text: Rinse as normal.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Tips:
settings.text: Tips:

settings.repere: Texte · Store the tube on its cap so the gel sit
settings.text: Store the tube on its cap so the gel sits at the tip.

settings.repere: Texte · Works with manual and electric brushes.
settings.text: Works with manual and electric brushes. With an electric brush, spread the gel across your teeth first, then switch it on.

settings.repere: Texte · Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twi
settings.text: Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twice-daily use.

settings.repere: Bouton · How do I know it’s working?
settings.text: How do I know it’s working?

settings.repere: Texte · First brush: run your tongue over your t
settings.text: First brush: run your tongue over your teeth. They should feel noticeably smoother and cleaner.

settings.repere: Texte · Morning breath: brush with LIVFRESH at n
settings.text: Morning breath: brush with LIVFRESH at night and notice how your breath feels the next morning.

settings.repere: Texte · Over the following weeks: teeth that sta
settings.text: Over the following weeks: teeth that stay cleaner for longer between brushings, fresher breath, and less buildup over time.

settings.repere: Texte · With Gum Protect+: you may see less pink
settings.text: With Gum Protect+: you may see less pink in the sink over time.

settings.repere: Texte · At your next cleaning: your hygienist ma
settings.text: At your next cleaning: your hygienist may notice the difference!

settings.repere: Bouton · How should I store LIVFRESH?
settings.text: How should I store LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Store at room temperature, out of direct
settings.text: Store at room temperature, out of direct sunlight, in a dry place, and secure the cap after each use. No special storage is required.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If you receive the tube in a cold winter
settings.text: If you receive the tube in a cold winter or hot summer, keep it at room temperature for 6 hours before opening.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe for all ages?
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH safe for all ages?

settings.repere: Texte · Fluoride-free gels: made with safe ingre
settings.text: Fluoride-free gels: made with safe ingredients for the whole family, with adult supervision for young children. Kids+ and Mild Peppermint are safe to swallow, and our non-foaming formulas are made with safe, food-grade ingredients.

settings.repere: Texte · Gum Protect+: for adults and children 12
settings.text: Gum Protect+: for adults and children 12 years of age and older. Do not swallow. Children under 12: ask a dentist.

settings.repere: Texte · Mouthwash: for ages 12 and over. Not for
settings.text: Mouthwash: for ages 12 and over. Not for children 11 and under.

settings.repere: Texte · Whitening Strips and Mobile System: adul
settings.text: Whitening Strips and Mobile System: adult supervision required under 12. Check with your dentist for younger users.

settings.repere: Bouton · Should I check with my dentist before us
settings.text: Should I check with my dentist before using LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is made for everyday use and do
settings.text: LIVFRESH is made for everyday use and doesn’t require a prescription. We always encourage keeping your dentist in the loop, especially if you have specific concerns or are undergoing treatment. LIVFRESH is supported by nearly 3,000 dentists and hygienists, so your dentist may already know us.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH on my pet?
settings.text: Can I use LIVFRESH on my pet?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We have a lot of customers who use our M
settings.text: We have a lot of customers who use our Mild Peppermint on their dogs. It’s non-foaming, dye-free, safe to swallow and made with safe, food-grade ingredients, which is why so many pet parents reach for it. Very importantly it does not contain Xylitol which is toxic to dogs and cats. That said, LIVFRESH wasn’t formulated to be a pet toothpaste, so please check with your vet first and start with a very small amount, since some animals can be sensitive to menthol.

settings.repere: Bouton · What can I expect when using LIVFRESH?
settings.text: What can I expect when using LIVFRESH?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · From your first brush: your teeth feel n
settings.text: From your first brush: your teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner, like you just left a professional cleaning. Run your tongue over your teeth: no more fuzzy feeling.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · With consistent brushing: LIVFRESH helps
settings.text: With consistent brushing: LIVFRESH helps keep your teeth cleaner for longer between brushings, and you may notice fresher breath (especially in the morning) and less plaque buildup over time. Brushing with LIVFRESH also helps reduce tartar build-up.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · With Gum Protect+: it helps control blee
settings.text: With Gum Protect+: it helps control bleeding gums associated with gingivitis, so if your gums bleed when you brush, you may see less pink in the sink over time.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Practical notes:
settings.text: Practical notes:

settings.repere: Texte · Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twi
settings.text: Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twice-daily, pea-sized use.

settings.repere: Texte · Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry
settings.text: Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry brush, and don’t wet the brush again after applying.

settings.repere: Texte · No foam in our non-foaming formulas is c
settings.text: No foam in our non-foaming formulas is completely normal. Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our patented formula does.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH if I have sensitive t
settings.text: Can I use LIVFRESH if I have sensitive teeth?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We always recommend checking with your d
settings.text: We always recommend checking with your dentist about tooth sensitivity. Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free, for an enamel-friendly clean, and if other toothpastes feel too harsh, LIVFRESH is a great alternative. For our gentlest option, try Mild Peppermint: no foam, no dye and a soft peppermint flavor. If you already use a sensitivity toothpaste, you can keep using it as your dentist recommends.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe during pregnancy or men
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH safe during pregnancy or menopause?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Please check with your doctor or dentist
settings.text: Please check with your doctor or dentist first, especially during pregnancy. Our fluoride-free gels are made with safe ingredients. Gum Protect+ contains stannous fluoride, so standard fluoride toothpaste directions apply. For our Mouthwash, check with your healthcare provider before use. If you’re noticing bleeding gums, Gum Protect+ helps control bleeding gums associated with gingivitis.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe if I have a medical con
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH safe if I have a medical condition?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free,
settings.text: Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free, and our fluoride-free formulas are made with safe ingredients. Because every situation is unique, please check with your healthcare provider or dentist before starting any new oral care product.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH appropriate during chemo or
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH appropriate during chemo or radiation?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every patient’s situation is unique, esp
settings.text: Every patient’s situation is unique, especially during active treatment, so please check with your oncologist and/or dentist before adding any new oral care product. If you’re looking for our gentlest option, Mild Peppermint is abrasive-free and SLS-free, with no foam and no dye. This community is close to our hearts, and we’re here to help however we can.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH suitable for kids with senso
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH suitable for kids with sensory sensitivities?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Kids+ Bubblegum and Mild Peppermint
settings.text: Yes. Kids+ Bubblegum and Mild Peppermint both have no foam and no dye, are safe to swallow, and are made with safe, food-grade ingredients. We always recommend adult supervision and checking with your child’s dentist for personalized guidance.

settings.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe for caps, bridges, vene
settings.text: Is LIVFRESH safe for caps, bridges, veneers, braces and dental work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is abrasive-free, so it’s gentl
settings.text: LIVFRESH is abrasive-free, so it’s gentle on caps, crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures, fillings, implants and braces. For braces, we recommend a foaming formula (Wintergreen or Arctic Peppermint) for easy spreading around brackets, plus our Mouthwash, which reaches the areas your brush may miss.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH with Invisalign or a
settings.text: Can I use LIVFRESH with Invisalign or a nightguard?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Brushing with LIVFRESH before putti
settings.text: Yes. Brushing with LIVFRESH before putting your aligners or nightguard in starts you off with a noticeably cleaner mouth, and LIVFRESH helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings. A quick rinse with our Mouthwash after brushing adds an extra layer of freshness. User feedback indicates that brushing with LIVFRESH reduces the odor that can be caused or is common with Invisalign and mouthguards.

settings.repere: Bouton · Can I use the Mouthwash with braces, ali
settings.text: Can I use the Mouthwash with braces, aligners or other dental appliances?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Rinse with LIVFRESH Mouthwash as pa
settings.text: Yes. Rinse with LIVFRESH Mouthwash as part of your regular routine. For aligners, a quick rinse after brushing and before reinserting them adds an extra layer of freshness. Check with your dentist or orthodontist for specific guidance.
